_comment: Hand-written SizeIndex (src/lib/size_index/types.ts) for the browser tests. Every level is a uniform leaf of 1024 bytes per tile, so a full download is sum(4^z for z in 0..6) * 1024 = 5592064 bytes = '5.33 MB' and any narrower selection is exactly computable in a test. Zoom ceiling is 6, well below the component's DEFAULT_MAX_ZOOM of 14, so tests can tell the two apart.
